title: Reverse String
description:
# Reverse String

Write a function that reverses a string. The input string is given as an array of characters `s`.

You must do this by modifying the input array [in-place](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/In-place_algorithm) with `O(1)` extra memory.

## Example 1:

**Input:** s = ["h","e","l","l","o"]
**Output:** ["o","l","l","e","h"]

## Example 2:

**Input:** s = ["H","a","n","n","a","h"]
**Output:** ["h","a","n","n","a","H"]

## Constraints:

*   `1 <= s.length <= 10^5`
*   `s[i]` is a printable ascii character.

solutions.name: Two Pointers
solutions.description: Use left and right pointers moving toward the center, swapping characters at each step.

solutions.name: Recursive Swap
solutions.description: Recursively swap the first and last characters, then recurse on the inner subarray.
